Each finished workout is saved there as a strength-training session, so other health apps show it.
After a workout, its average and maximum heart rate and active calories are read from Health Connect and saved with it.
Health Connect is not available on this phone.
Install or update Health Connect to use it here.
Health Connect did not give the permission. You can grant it in Health Connect\'s settings and try again.

If you turn on “Write workouts to Health Connect” in Settings, Tung saves each workout you finish there as a strength-training session, with a segment for each set of an exercise Health Connect knows. Nothing else is written.

If you turn on “Read heart rate and calories”, Tung reads your heart rate and active calories for the time of each workout you finish, and saves the average and maximum heart rate and the calories with that workout. Nothing outside your workouts is read.

These values stay in Tung on this phone. If you sync with a Tung server you chose in Settings, they are stored there with the workout, like the rest of it. Tung has no analytics and sends them nowhere else.
You can turn either off in Tung\'s Settings and revoke the permissions in Health Connect at any time.
